The question asks whether the value of `tmp1` used at line 24 depends on the value of `tmp2` at line 22. Looking at the code, `tmp1` and `tmp2` are independent variables - they are assigned different method calls (`getSourceFile()` vs `getDestDirectory()`) and are used as separate parameters in the function call. The value of `tmp1` is not constructed or derived from `tmp2` in any way.

The answer is No.

They are then both used as separate parameters in the extractFileIfIncluded method call at line 24. The value of tmp1 is not constructed or derived from tmp2, so tmp1 does not depend on tmp2.
